title: Celeste Costs You 59¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Celeste is $4.99 on Steam right now (75% off $19.99) and the main story takes about 8.5 hours (HowLongToBeat): 59¢ an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 28 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 deaths in Celeste: it's $4.99 right now, 59¢ an hour.
